statement: For every integer n ≥ 0 and every DCC set Ψ ⊂ [0, 1] ∩ Q, there is an integer a(n, Ψ) > 0 such that every normal integral projective lc pair (V, ∆) over C with dim V = n, ∆ ≥ 0, coefficients in Ψ, and KV + ∆ ∼Q 0 satisfies a(n, Ψ)(KV + ∆) ∼ 0. Here the displayed multiple is an integral principal divisor.
